instruction: How much money have I received to my coworkers on venmo since 1st Feb of this year?
notes: Read-only information task: no database changes are made, so the goal only demands that the total received amount is found and the task completed with it as the answer. The set of coworker contacts is unknown at modeling time, so it is modeled as one group person object (coworkers) with one representative email object (coworker-emails); at runtime phone.search_contacts (query/relationship = coworkers) is paginated and venmo.show_transactions (direction=received, min_created_at=2023-02-01, user_email=each coworker email) is repeated per coworker email and paginated, summing the amounts. supervisor.show_profile supplies the login usernames (phone number for phone, email for venmo); phone.get_current_date_and_time supplies the current year used to build the threshold date. supervisor-complete-task is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every other action.

warnings: domain: pddl-lib parser: types ['object'] of term Variable(c) are not in available types {'relationship', 'app', 'token', 'email', 'direction', 'date', 'password', 'username', 'amount', 'person', 'query'}

plan: (venmo-show-transactions venmo-token coworker-emails date-2023-02-01 direction-received coworkers total-received-amount)
